name: 87020 · Grants, NM
findings: ZIP 87020 (Grants) has 24 nonprofit organizations. 6 of them (25%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 5 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (40% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 87020 (Grants) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list public events
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 87020 (Grants) list public events on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 58% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 5 organizations here; 33% of all organizations here have no identified type.
